content:
Found it! The **frontend** pod has `dnsPolicy=None` with `dnsConfig.nameservers: ["8.8.8.8"]` (Google's public DNS) instead of the standard `ClusterFirst` DNS policy that all other pods use. This causes all internal Kubernetes service DNS lookups to fail. Let me confirm by checking the deployment spec.

```bash
kubectl --server=https://host.docker.internal:16443 --token=[credential masked] --insecure-skip-tls-verify -n astronomy-shop get deployment frontend -o yaml 2>&1 | grep -A 10 -i "dns"
```
